body: @t1 which kind of logging do you mean? I mean, which logging API is used in your app and what logging libraries are on the class path?

We use slf4j.

I found that the `LoggingSetupExtension` has to be loaded, so the `LoggingSetupRecorder` configures the log handlers.

> I found that the `LoggingSetupExtension` has to be loaded, so the `LoggingSetupRecorder` configures the log handlers.

Hm, I've tried to add the `quarkus-junit5-config` dependency but it didn't really help 🤔.

When I tried to add the `org.slf4j:slf4j-simple` dependency I got a warning about multiple SLF4J providers found, and the actual provider was `org.slf4j.impl.JBossSlf4jServiceProvider` coming from `org.jboss.slf4j:slf4j-jboss-logmanager` (adaptor for SLF4J which delegates to the JBoss Log Manager). So indeed, it looks like some logging misconfiguration. ~~By the way, `org.jboss.logging.Logger` does not work either.~~ UPDATE: `quarkus-junit5-config`  does help with `org.jboss.logging.Logger`.
And if you use `quarkus-junit5`, does slf4j work fine?

> And if you use `quarkus-junit5`, does slf4j work fine?

It does work in a `@QuarkusTest`.

With https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/42715, we made a lot of changes to make things more consistent.

Previously, we had `junit5-properties` just to set `junit-platform.properties`. Since we need a way to bootstrap Config property, in both Quarkus and standalone tests, I've created `junit5-config`, including setting the logger even outside a Quarkus test, so I would expect this would work with Component too.

I'll try to have a look.

Yes, I believe there is an issue with the CLs. What I'm observing is `QuarkusDelayedHandler` being initialized twice for separate CLs, depending on where you have your Logger declaration.

Well, since you are more familiar with that work, will you look into it? :)

issue.title: QuarkusComponentTest: make sure logging is always initialized
issue.body:
- i.e. even when quarkus-junit5 is not present
- also delegate class loading for SLF4J, jboss-logging and jboss-logmanager to the parent CL
- fixes #51117
